in_sanskrit.name: Dungar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Fort, Hill
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dungar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘durg’ meaning fort or hill, Dungar is a powerful and majestic name often associated with strength, protection, and stability. In Hindu mythology, Dungar is the name of several deities, including Dungar Devta and Dungar Baba, who are revered for their protective and fortifying powers.
